file_subset_policy: Roman-general 1960/1962 build-out subset -- the Latin content this lane's minimum shippable floor (architecture doc §10) needs: full Tempora/Sancti/Commune/Psalterium/Appendix, plus the 1960-rubric Martyrologium. Deliberately excludes monastic/Dominican/Cistercian variant directories (TemporaM/SanctiM/CommuneM, TemporaCist/SanctiCist/CommuneCist, TemporaOP/SanctiOP/CommuneOP), the pre-1955/1960 Martyrologium editions (Martyrologium1570, Martyrologium1955R), Regula (Benedictine Rule readings, monastic-only), and Necrologium -- all out of scope per architecture §11's 'no monastic or Dominican variants.'
